categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property encumbrances. The content falls under PART III - LANDS and focuses on land registration and title settlement, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
